summary: Master grant PMO and donor-funded programme delivery with practical tools, dashboards, and reporting templates. Book this 5-day course today.
lede: Grant PMO practice structures how funded programmes are planned, monitored and documented. Designed for professionals involved in grants, reporting, delivery coordination or compliance, the course covers implementation planning, milestone and budget monitoring, and donor reporting. Practical exercises include building delivery trackers and risk registers, reviewing budget variances, and preparing reporting packs with supporting evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch grants, reporting, delivery coordination, or compliance and need stronger control over funded programmes. Grant Managers coordinating compliance, budgets, and donor reporting. PMO Coordinators tracking milestones across funded workplans. Programme Officers managing implementation and field delivery evidence. Donor Compliance Specialists reviewing award conditions and reporting obligations. Finance Officers controlling burn rates and eligible expenditure. M&E Officers linking indicators to donor results frameworks. Partnership Managers overseeing sub-grants and partner reporting. Project Directors steering grant portfolios and escalation decisions. Procurement Officers supporting donor-funded sourcing and contract controls. Operations Leads aligning delivery, evidence, and audit preparation.
outcomes: Donor Reporting And Corrective Action Planning
prerequisites: You should arrive with a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel, and the ability to review a recent grant workplan, budget, or donor report. A basic understanding of project cycles, indicators, and donor-funded administration will help you move faster through the practical exercises.
